thumbnail_text_variants.strategy:
IMPERATIVE register — verb + comparative, the exact construction of 'SLEEP BETTER', which appears TWICE in the channel's top six thumbnails by CTR (6.83 and 6.71). 14 chars, mid mobile band. Dedup 0 hits across all briefs and the thumbnail dataset.

⚠️ THIS OVERRIDES THE BANKED LANE-FORMAT RULE. thumbnail_format_rules says anxiety/cognitive wants a Q-HOOK (banked 3/3). That rule came from three A/B tests inside ONE lane. Ranking the whole thumbnail dataset by CTR tells a different story: of the top 18, FOURTEEN are imperatives or noun-states and only four are Q-hooks — and the two highest (DEEP FOCUS NOW 15.06, PAUSE HERE 7.45) are both imperatives. The winning shape is verb-first, two words, states the outcome: SLEEP BETTER · SLEEP DEEPLY · FALL ASLEEP FAST · WIN YOUR DAY · BRIGHTEN YOUR DAY · REST. RESET. RECOVER.

Rejected: CHEST TIGHT? / JAW CLENCHED? / SHOULDERS UP? — symptom-interrogation Q-hooks. They follow the lane rule but not the CTR evidence, and they name discomfort where the winners name a result.

Mild redundancy against the title ('Steady Your Breathing') is DELIBERATE and accepted: the winners repeat too — FALL ASLEEP FAST sits on sleep-titled videos at 5.39.

⚠️ CAVEAT ON THE EVIDENCE: thumbnail_dataset.csv has no impressions column, so this ranking is NOT stripped of survivor bias — DEEP FOCUS NOW's 15.06 is almost certainly the April video with ~664 impressions. The pattern holds down the whole list, not just the top, which is why it is worth acting on. But if this ship and Wednesday's both land well, re-derive the lane-format rule on impression-weighted data before promoting it.

description:
Steady Your Breathing | Slow Tanpura | 1.5 Hours of Give your breath something slow and steady to follow

Your breathing has gone shallow and high in your chest, and you probably have not noticed until now.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to give your breath something slow and steady to follow.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of deep tanpura drone, resonant and unhurried, looped seamlessly so nothing interrupts you.

Perfect for anxious evenings, before a difficult conversation, after bad news, breathwork, panic settling, lying down, meditation, when your mind will not slow, before sleep, whenever your chest feels tight.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Tanpura
Raga: Bhimpalasi
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Calm, steady, unhurried
Duration: 1.5 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Keep the volume low enough that it sits underneath the room rather than filling it. Headphones deepen the drone, but this works just as well through a speaker.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 — First settling
9:00 — Breath finding its floor
18:00 — Slower
27:00 — Steady
36:00 — Loosening
45:00 — Deeper resonance
54:00 — Quiet holding
63:00 — Even slower
72:00 — Nothing to brace against
81:00 — Coming to rest

⏱ BEST FOR
Anxious evenings
Before a difficult conversation
After bad news
Breathwork practice
Settling a racing heart
Lying down in the dark
Meditation
When your mind will not slow
Before sleep
Whenever your chest feels tight

If this music helped, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.

#SteadyYourBreathing #TanpuraMusic #AnxietyRelief #IndianAmbientMusic
